Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4303805 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter activities by assay_chembl_id. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
